primary_stat_rule: Every generated equipment item bound to a target character must redistribute all generated primary-stat chunks through the canonical target-class and equipment-kind/subtype policy, regardless of class_aware_chance.
weighted_identity_rule: class_aware_chance remains authoritative only for slot/type/profile/armor-type/subtype selection unless a later explicit policy changes it.
unchanged_randomness: armor type and weapon/off-hand subtype selection under current weighted branch
shop_contract: Shop preview remains always target-class weighted; purchase promotes the same preview snapshot without reroll.
loot_contract: Both current class-aware and unrestricted loot branches must apply canonical target-class primary-stat redistribution before persistence.
dev_contract: DEV generation must no longer default to unrestricted primary stats; it must follow the target character class matrix.
event_contract: Any event path creating generated equipment for a character must use the same canonical primary-stat enforcement.
simulator_contract: Simulator equipment generation must use or exactly mirror the canonical production primary-stat policy.
fallback_contract: Unknown/unsupported class fails closed: do not persist generated equipment with arbitrary primary stats; return an explicit generation error.
existing_items: No retroactive migration or reroll of already existing equipment in inventories, auctions, shops or history.
